artifact_observations.reasoning: The fingers of the right hand (visible near the glove) appear slightly indistinct and merge softly with the glove leather, lacking sharp anatomical definition typical of high-res photography.
The anatomy of the right knee and lower thigh appears somewhat compressed and lacks clear structural definition against the background, possibly due to motion blur simulation or generation artifact.
The background grass has a uniform, painterly smoothness that lacks the random variation of real grass, suggesting AI-generated texture rather than optical depth-of-field blur.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the subject is correctly classified as a baseball player and not a generic athlete or other sport participant.
To verify the skeletal structure of the diving pose, ensuring limb count and joint angles are biologically plausible despite the dynamic motion.
To inspect the boundary between the hand and the glove for fusion artifacts or missing fingers, which are common failure points in AI generation.
To assess overall image coherence, lighting consistency, and detect subtle texture anomalies in the uniform and background.
